items.headline: Drought, fire and high diesel prices 'addin' up tough' for Oregon ranchers
items.summary: Record diesel prices are kicking Western ranchers while they're down. Drought means they have to buy extra hay, and pay truckers extra to deliver it because of fuel price hikes. (Image credit: Anna King)
